root.label: Taliban Afghanistan crisis five years into rule

events.label: Taliban Afghanistan crisis five years into rule

slots.name: decrees issued
slots.sentence: More than 160 decrees have been issued targeting women and girls, barring them from secondary and higher education and restricting their employment, movement, dress, speech and decision-making.

slots.name: survey participants
slots.sentence: The agency surveyed about 5,000 Afghans in rural and urban communities this past spring and last year, asking women and men about life under the Taliban.

slots.name: men worse lives
slots.sentence: More than half of men surveyed — about 55 percent — said their lives were worse than they had expected they would be before August 2021, compared with 65 percent of women who reported a similar sentiment.

slots.name: women worse lives
slots.sentence: More than half of men surveyed — about 55 percent — said their lives were worse than they had expected they would be before August 2021, compared with 65 percent of women who reported a similar sentiment.

slots.name: permission to leave
slots.sentence: A vast majority of the women surveyed — 90 percent — said they must have a male family member’s permission to leave the house.

slots.name: male daily departures
slots.sentence: Among male survey respondents, more than 95 percent reported leaving their homes daily.

slots.name: behavior pressure
slots.sentence: The U.N. report noted that nearly 40 percent of women surveyed this year said they felt more pressure than before to tailor their behavior for fear that those they know will report them for inappropriate dress, speech or actions.

slots.name: women and girls erased
slots.sentence: “The greatest danger facing Afghanistan today is not only that 20 million women and girls are being systematically erased from public life,” Ms. Ahmadi wrote.

slots.name: women monthly outings
slots.sentence: And more than half said they went out only once or twice a month.

slots.name: takeover date
slots.sentence: The Taliban took over Afghanistan five years ago this week.

slots.name: forcibly returned Afghans
slots.sentence: Nearly four million Afghans have been forcibly returned from Iran and Pakistan since January 2025 — one of the world’s largest episodes of reverse migration in decades.
